sentences.text:
Shimla Jal Prabandhan Nigam Ltd. vs . H.P. State Human Rights
on 7 April, 2025
Shimla Jal Prabandhan Nigam Ltd. vs. H.P. State Human Rights Commission & Anr.
Cmpmo No. 138 of 2025.

Present: Mr. Shrawan Dogra, Senior Advocate with Mr. Tejasvi Dogra & Bhanvi Negi,
Advocate, for the petitioner.
Cmpmo No. 138 of 2025.
1. Notice to the respondents, returnable for 2nd June, 2025.
Steps be taken within a week.
Cmp No. 6396 of 2025.

2. Notice in the aforesaid terms.
3.

Learned senior counsel for the petitioner has prayed for ex-parte interim order on the ground that
the date fixed for compliance of impugned order is 8th April, 2025.

4.  The respondent-Commission by way of impugned order has issued direction to the petitioner herein to acquire the property of respondent No.2 herein under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Initially the action taken report was ordered to be submitted on 5 th March, 2025 and now it has been extended till 8th April, 2025.

5. The impugned order has been passed by the respondent-Commission primarily on the ground that the petitioner herein has made an admission in its evidence on affidavit showing its readiness to acquired the property of the complainant.

6. Learned Senior Counsel has taken me through the contents of the affidavit filed by the petitioner herein before the respondent-Commission, a copy of which has been placed on record as Annexure P-3.
Prima facie, I have not been able to find any such categoric admission of the petitioner herein with respect to the claim of complainant.
7. Petitioner has been able to make out a prima face case.

Accordingly, till next date of hearing, the operation and execution of impugned order dated 15.01.2025, passed by the H.P. Human Rights Commission, Shimla in Complaint No.245 of 2023, titled as Chaman Lal vs. Jal Shakti Rural Division at Sunni, District Shimla, H.P., shall remain stayed.
